title: Dry, label and store home-saved seed
subcategory: Dry, label and store home-saved seed
summary: Protect viability by drying seed correctly, preventing moisture return and keeping complete lot records.
steps: Remove pulp, chaff and visibly damaged seed using the crop-appropriate dry or wet cleaning method.
Dry seed in a shaded, ventilated, protected place until it reaches the safe condition described for that crop.
Package only fully dried seed in clean labelled containers; include crop, variety, location, harvest year and any treatment.
Store cool, dark and dry, protected from insects, rodents and temperature swings.
Inspect periodically and run a labelled germination test before committing scarce bed space.
warnings: Sealing seed while still damp can cause mould, heating and rapid loss of viability.
Keep treated planting seed physically separate from food grain.
common_mistakes: Scaling up before a small controlled trial.
